savol: For each of the four statements about the presence of bias within information sources, evaluate whether it is True or False:
variantlar: Statements from official, verified accounts on social media are trustworthy and without bias.
The tone of an information source is important as it can lead to an outsized sense of imminence or impact.
The policies and views of publishers and media owners should be reported in a transparent and ethical way.
An eyewitness account of a news event is more likely to be credible than a source who must rely on others to provide information.

savol: After meeting with a client, the client told your teacher that your team needs to improve its communication skills. Which two actions should you take to improve your communication skills? (Choose 2.)

variantlar.A: Continue the same approach so your team can improve with practice
variantlar.B: Individually text the client to apologize for your poor communication
variantlar.C: Have another team member take over the communication at the next meeting.
variantlar.D: Ask your teacher for feedback on which communication skills you need to improve

savol: A classmate is asking for assistance editing a document to help improve readability when posted online. Which two options are the best ways to achieve that? (Choose 2.)

variantlar.A: Encourage them to minimize the use of excessive punctuation and sentences that span multiple lines
variantlar.B: Have them check the text against the grade level it reads at to ensure alignment of message and audience
variantlar.C: Ensure that there is limited contrast between the type and the background to ensure readability on all types of screens.
variantlar.D: Remind them to add accessibility features, like closed captions

savol: Your teacher has assigned a group project. Part of the grade includes evaluation of each team member's positive contributions. Select the three statements that best demonstrate your ability to contribute productively to a group. (Choose 3.)

variantlar.A: Agree with your teacher's recommendations on the division for the project's scope
variantlar.B: Agree to a set of norms concerning the online group conversation
variantlar.C: Save discussion of deliverable format until a later meeting
variantlar.D: Set a series of deadlines throughout the project to keep all members accountable
variantlar.E: Do extra work to compensate for group members who are not doing their share

savol: You see that a classmate has posted content on social media that seems concerning and out of character. For each of the four proposed courses of action, mark True if it is something you should do, or False if it is not an appropriate course of action:
variantlar: Respond in the comments of the post with questions about their mental state.
Report the content to have it removed, saving your classmate embarrassment and consequences.
Take screenshots of the content to show to a trusted adult so they can offer additional support(s).
Assume that they are posting impulsively and ignore the post.

variantlar.A: Create a digital portfolio that is accessible to everyone on the internet
variantlar.B: Put a disclaimer in all your posts stating that all content is your intellectual property
variantlar.C: Place a watermark over all publicly shared content
variantlar.D: Create a Creative Commons license, allowing others to use your work with attribution
